theorems.statement: ∀ (Γ Δ : Subgroup (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ)) (R : Finset (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ)) (F : Set UpperHalfPlane), Δ ≤ Γ → (-1 : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ∈ Δ → (∀ r ∈ R, r ∈ Γ) → (∀ γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, γ ∈ Γ → ∃ r ∈ R, γ * r⁻¹ ∈ Δ) → (∀ r ∈ R, ∀ s ∈ R, s * r⁻¹ ∈ Δ → s = r) → MeasurableSet F → (∀ᵐ z ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane), ∃ γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, γ ∈ Γ ∧ γ • z ∈ F ∧ ∀ δ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, δ ∈ Γ → δ • z ∈ F → δ = γ ∨ δ = -γ) → let E : Set UpperHalfPlane := ⋃ r ∈ R, (fun z : UpperHalfPlane => r • z) '' F; MeasurableSet E ∧ (∀ᵐ z ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane), ∃ γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, γ ∈ Δ ∧ γ • z ∈ E ∧ ∀ δ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, δ ∈ Δ → δ • z ∈ E → δ = γ ∨ δ = -γ) ∧ (∀ᵐ z ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane), ∀ r ∈ R, ∀ s ∈ R, z ∈ (fun w : UpperHalfPlane => r • w) '' F → z ∈ (fun w : UpperHalfPlane => s • w) '' F → r = s)
